finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Yep,” she also smiled. “Okay, there have been some problems with the hired security. You know how those formation masters are, needing everything to be just perfect. The other security personnel are also a bit of a hassle to deal with, but their leader keeps them on short leashes so they don’t cause too many problems before the big auction.”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “According to my father, we’re way behind schedule,” the beastkin woman answered in a deadpan tone.
